title: VendeeInput
description: Every input the navigation engine receives: one map with a tag. There are no buttons; Location and Wake come from the host.

oneOf.title: Location
oneOf.description: A GPS update: anywhere from once a second to once every few minutes.

timestamp.description: When the fix was taken, epoch ms.

fix.description: Where we are; null if the GPS has no position.

altitude.description: Metres above sea level; null or absent if unknown.

velocity.description: How we are moving; null if unknown.

heading.description: Course over ground, degrees true, 0 up to 360.

oneOf.title: Wake
oneOf.description: The wake time the engine asked for has come (may also arrive late or unasked).
